sector_093_definition.definition: This sector covers oil-processing refineries. Products of this sector are gasoline, jet oil, LPG, asphalt, paraffin, sulfur, kerosene, diesel and fuel oil.
sector_093_definition.label: Petroleum refineries

summary.note: Baht of sector-093 output purchased per baht of industry gross output, purchasers' prices, import-inclusive, one 2015 benchmark under fixed proportions. Not an elasticity, not a pass-through rate, not a causal effect. A large exposure is a structural fact, not an error.

proxy_fitness.absence_of_evidence_note: The 179-sector table does not split refinery products by type, so no source Phase A may read identifies which product an industry buys. That is a limit of the permitted sources, not proof that no such evidence exists anywhere.
proxy_fitness.basket_source: NESDC 2015 sector classification, definition of sector 093

valuation.prohibited_claim: Multiplying the EPPO price by the I/O coefficient does NOT produce baht cost per unit of industrial output. The price stage and the valuation basis differ.
